# SvgPanel

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Front panel drawn in a vector editor: elements labelled awi:<role>=<name>;<option>=<value> are bound to value[<name>] (IND-120 .. IND-126).

![SvgPanel, light theme](../img/widgets/svg-panel-light.png#only-light){ width="228" }
![SvgPanel, dark theme](../img/widgets/svg-panel-dark.png#only-dark){ width="228" }

**Custom front panels** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.SvgPanel) ·
schema [`svgpanel.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.SvgPanel.template(
    "voltmeter",
    value={"value": 6.4},
    label="SvgPanel voltmeter",
    size=(220, 200),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"control"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `size` | array | `[400,300]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `svg` | string | `""` | host | SVG document. Python sanitizes it; the front end sanitizes it again (no scripts, event handlers or external resources). A role is read from the data-awi attribute of an element, else from its inkscape:label attribute. |
| `value` | object | `{}` | host, widget | Values of the bound names: numbers, texts, Booleans or null (shown as a dash). Written by the host, and by the operator through control roles in control mode; the kernel refuses a step value outside its limits. |
| `problems` | array of string | `[]` | host | Elements with an unknown role or an invalid option, as '<element>: <reason>' (IND-125). Computed by Python; without a kernel the front end shows its own list. |
| `show_entries` | boolean | `true` | host | Show an entry field for each value of a step control (IND-124). |
